description_excerpt: ABOUT THE ROLE As Customs Declaration Manager, you will lead the day-to-day declaration operations, ensuring every filing is accurate, timely, and fully compliant with Vietnam customs regulations. You are the operational bridge between the Compliance Team, Operations Team, and the Declarants, responsible for final review, workload management, system administration, and team performance.
